name: fisis
description: Read FSS FISIS financial-institution statistics from the command line, powered by the fisis CLI

interface.longDescription: List a financial sector's companies, browse its statistics catalog, list a statistic's account items, then fetch that statistic's observations as a time series (with per-column units and the settlement date) from the FSS FISIS Open API via the fisis CLI. Needs a free FISIS API key in FISIS_API_KEY.
defaultPrompt: List the FISIS companies in the life-insurance sector
Browse the FISIS statistics catalog for banks
Fetch a FISIS statistic as a time series
